summary_points.text: The project manager opened the kick-off meeting and the team members introduced themselves and their roles
The team will design a new remote control that is original, trendy and user friendly, in three design stages
The remote will sell for 25 Euro internationally, with a production cost of at most 12.50 Euro and a profit target of 50 million Euro
The project manager assigned work for the next meeting to the industrial designer, the user interface designer and the marketing expert

decisions.text: The remote control will sell for 25 Euro
The remote control will be sold on an international scale
The production cost must not exceed 12.50 Euro, half of the selling price
The profit target is 50 million Euro
